_doc: EVS fact tables (KG-5), built by boretube-learn/tools/content/data/evs_data.py; edit there, not here. A missing field means unknown or arguable, so generators never use it. animals: n, an (article 'an'), pl (plural), group (mammal/bird/reptile/fish/insect/amphibian/other), contested (never in group, birth or flying questions: bat, whale, dolphin, penguin, spider...), kg (familiar to small children), both (lives on land and in water), hab (forest/grassland/desert/snow/sea/fresh/farm/house/mountain/soil), home (first is the main one; all true ones listed), food (herbivore/carnivore/omnivore), cover (fur/hair/wool/feathers/scales/shell/skin), young, legs, birth (eggs/live), kind (pet/farm/wild), size (1 tiny..7 huge), flies, sound/noise, beak/feet (birds), moves/cannot (fly/swim/hop/crawl), pic (picture id). plants: type (tree/shrub/herb/climber/creeper), uses (products), seeds (wind/water/animal/burst) and why, none (gives no special product, a safe wrong option). foods: form (s 'a mango', pl 'grapes', m 'rice'), fv (fruit/veg), src (plant/animal), part (root/stem/leaf/flower/fruit/seed), rich/poor (c carbohydrates, p proteins, f fats, v vitamins and minerals), cook (raw/cooked/both), method (steam/fry/bake/boil/roast), health (healthy/junk), taste. objects: made (materials), magnetic, seeThrough, floats, waste (wet/dry), natural, feel (hard/soft). helpers: tools, places, does, makes. transport: mode (land/water/air), wheels, power. india: 28 states and 8 UTs (since 2020) with capital, languages, dances, festivals only where unambiguous. festivals: month/date only when fixed; features (true) and maybe (partly true, never a wrong option). The rest are small scenario tables.
